svg.aria-label: No noise: raw security findings from 8 specialist agents ride a belt into a confidence check machine run by the three bots. False alarms, like a template that already auto-escapes or a test fixture, drop into a bin with their reason. Duplicates from two agents merge and confidence goes up. Real findings reach the report with a severity and a confidence meter: 23 raw findings in, 11 real ones out.
